s.g: (biblical) The pile of stones erected by Jacob and Laban as a figurative watchtower to mark their separation.
(by extension) An emotional bond between people who are separated.
Of, or relating to Jews of Middle Eastern origin, and their traditions, customs, and rituals.
One of several tangy green vegetables used in Japanese cuisine, usually Brassica rapa var. nipposinica
(nautical) The aftmost mast on a ship having three masts; the third-tallest mast on a full-rigged ship.
(nautical) The third-foremost mast on a ship having more than three masts.
(nautical) The second mast of a ship having two masts where the second one is shorter, such as a ketch or yawl.
(intransitive, UK, Canada, US, chiefly dialectal) To rain in very fine drops.
A mist; a fine spray; a spattering.
(transitive) To muddle or confuse. (Probably from a misreading of past tense/participle misled.)
(dialectal or obsolete) A bog or quagmire.
